chunks: Or that He will not seize them as they move about, and they will not be able to elude (His grasp);
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when Allah seizes people in their movement?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights Allah's omnipresence in the dynamic flow of human affairs, illustrating that divine power is not static but actively engaged in the 'turbulence' of worldly movement. It serves as a reminder that no one can evade His grasp through speed or agility, reinforcing the concept of divine omniscience and control over both the seen and unseen realms.
